Outfit - U.A. School Uniform.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: U.A.'s standard uniform. A light gray blazer with dark green edging along the collar and lapels, worn over a white collared shirt with a wide red necktie; dark green trousers or a dark green pleated skirt ending above the knee, whichever the character wears; dark leather loafers. Neat, pressed and slightly worn in. No lettering or badges. Cut openings for any established wings, tail or extra arms.

Portrait only: inventory and equipped items stay as they are. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; the garment adds no Quirk effect, gear function, rank, license or affiliation. Respect the selected crop.
